articles.headline: Ramayana and Scene Dominate Diwali Box Office with 1100 Crore Plus Worldwide Gross in Just One Week
articles.dek: Namit Malhotra's Ramayana and Suriya's Scene deliver a massive Diwali box office performance with strong domestic and overseas collections.

p: Diwali 2026 has provided a massive boost to the Indian film industry. Two major titles hitting theatres just a single day apart have successfully drawn enormous crowds.
The festive scheduling created a highly rewarding window for both Bollywood and Kollywood, bringing in substantial numbers from ticket buyers.
The theatrical run of these two pictures generated an estimated combined global gross exceeding 1100 crore in just one week.
Both domestic theatre chains and international exhibitors experienced heavy footfall, reflecting the immense pulling power of the holiday season.
Namit Malhotra's production stands as the primary financial contributor to the festive haul. The Nitesh Tiwari directorial saw its numbers surge significantly after the opening weekend.
Its multilingual release strategy, widespread family appeal, and favorable holiday timing helped sustain its initial momentum across multiple territories.
Suriya's starring vehicle carved out a formidable theatrical footprint during the same festive window. The production relied heavily on its regional markets.
Strong audience interest within Kerala, supported by its Malayalam creative team, and solid numbers in Tamil Nadu anchored its domestic performance.
Despite sharing the exact same holiday release window, the two features drew in viewers through distinctly separate strengths and regional loyalties.
Ramayana captured massive Hindi-led business alongside strong dubbed contributions in Telugu and Kannada, while Scene anchored itself firmly in southern markets.
Overseas audiences played a vital role in the overall financial success, accounting for roughly a third of the combined business generated by both films.
This solid international turnout highlights the far-reaching appeal of both Hindi and Tamil productions in global theatrical markets.
With the initial festive rush concluding, the next major hurdle for these releases involves maintaining audience retention during regular working days.
Future box office performance will heavily depend on screen allocations, weekday drop-offs, and how well the titles perform heading into their second weekend.

Namit Malhotra's Ramayana and Suriya's Scene dominated the Diwali 2026 box office by pulling in an estimated 1100 crore plus in worldwide gross within a single week. Both titles capitalized on the festive holiday period through strong domestic appeal and robust international markets.

facts: Namit Malhotra's Ramayana and Suriya's Scene achieved an estimated 1100+ crore worldwide gross.
Ramayana earned ₹605 Cr India gross, ₹325 Cr overseas gross, totaling ₹930 Cr over 7 days.
Scene earned ₹123 Cr India gross, ₹67 Cr overseas gross, totaling ₹190 Cr over 6 days.
Combined totals reached ₹728+ Cr India gross, ₹392 Cr overseas gross, and ₹1120+ Cr worldwide gross.
Ramayana was released on Thursday, November 5, 2026, reaching ₹440.45 Cr India net and ₹825.00 Cr worldwide gross.

articles.headline: Anirudh Ravichander And Kavya Maran Tie The Knot In A Dreamy Outdoor Ceremony
articles.dek: Music composer Anirudh Ravichander and Sunrisers Hyderabad co-owner Kavya Maran have officially married, sharing a stunning first look from their ceremony.

p: Renowned music composer Anirudh Ravichander has entered a new chapter of his life by marrying Kavya Maran, the co-owner of the Sunrisers Hyderabad cricket franchise. The couple shared their joyous news directly with followers through social media channels.
The announcement immediately captured the attention of fans and industry peers alike, sparking immense celebration across digital platforms following the surprise reveal.

Anirudh took to his official Instagram account to publish a captivating snapshot from the nuptials. The newly married couple can be seen strolling hand-in-hand together at what appears to be a scenic outdoor wedding venue.
Falling flower petals create a magical atmosphere around them as they traverse the decorated pathway, capturing a candid and tender moment of their celebration.
Reports indicate that the wedding celebrations are unfolding against a picturesque backdrop located in Greece. The picturesque destination provides a breathtaking setting for the high-profile union.

Elaborate design choices define the venue, featuring magnificent arrangements of white and yellow flowers. These intricate floral decorations extend gracefully across the entire background of the ceremony space.

Kavya Maran selected a gorgeous floor-length dusty rose-pink lehenga for her wedding day look. The exquisite ensemble featured detailed floral embroidery, complemented by sparkling sequins and fine embellishments.
She accessorized her traditional outfit with a striking statement necklace and matching earrings. Her hair was styled loose in soft, cascading waves to complete her elegant appearance.

Anirudh opted for a sophisticated and traditional ivory-beige aesthetic for the joyous occasion. His outfit consisted of a light-colored kurta paired with an intricately embroidered jacket and a matching veshti.
To finish his ceremonial look, he wore a distinct chain featuring a pendant, blending classic traditional tailoring with contemporary personal style.
Accompanying the widely shared wedding photograph on Instagram, Anirudh included a deeply romantic and minimalist caption for his followers to read.
He wrote, My once in a lifetime, for a lifetime, followed by a red heart emoji and the numerical digits 11.11, marking a significant timestamp for the pairing.

Music composer Anirudh Ravichander has married Sunrisers Hyderabad co-owner Kavya Maran in a celebration reportedly held in Greece. Anirudh shared a photograph on Instagram showing the couple walking hand-in-hand amidst elaborate floral arrangements, accompanied by the caption 11.11.

facts: Anirudh Ravichander married Kavya Maran
Kavya Maran is the co-owner of Sunrisers Hyderabad
The wedding celebrations are reportedly taking place in Greece
Anirudh posted the wedding photo on Instagram with the caption My once in a lifetime, for a lifetime ❤️ 11.11

images.caption: Anirudh Ravichander And Kavya Maran Tie The Knot In A Dreamy Outdoor Ceremony

articles.headline: Dennis Quaid's A Dog's Perfect Christmas Becomes the Biggest Movie on Netflix
articles.dek: Dennis Quaid leads the new streaming hit A Dog's Perfect Christmas, capturing the number one spot globally on Netflix with millions of views in its first week.

p: Dennis Quaid has established a strong presence on Netflix throughout the year. Following his appearance in the action thriller War Machine earlier in March, the veteran actor returned with a brand new holiday feature that quickly claimed the top spot across the platform's global streaming charts.

Released on November 4, A Dog's Perfect Christmas stars Dennis Quaid as Sander Goss, a widower trying to navigate life following the passing of his wife. Financial strain forces him to move in with his son, where his frustrated demeanor causes friction at home, particularly with his teenage granddaughter Ello, played by Brooke Lena Johnson.

The domestic situation intensifies further when the homeowner, Juliana—played by Kathleen Rose Perkins—falls ill and requires an induced coma. To lighten the heavy atmosphere, Ello introduces a Corgi puppy named Ruby, who joins the household alongside the family's wise basset hound, Winston, voiced by Thomas Haden Church.

Alongside Quaid and Johnson, the heartwarming feature includes several notable television and film stars. The cast features Milo Ventimiglia, recognized for his work in Heroes and This Is Us, alongside acclaimed actress Mary Steenburgen and comedic icon Jennifer Tilly.

The holiday project wasted no time capturing audience attention upon its streaming debut. Data published by Tudum confirmed that for the tracking week of November 2 through November 8, A Dog's Perfect Christmas ranked as the most popular English-language motion picture worldwide on Netflix.

During its initial four days available on the service, the movie accumulated 8.6 million total views, translating to 14.5 million hours watched. It successfully outperformed competition like the 2001 thriller Heist starring Gene Hackman, which secured the second position with 6.3 million views.

Despite sharing thematic similarities and a connection to author W. Bruce Cameron, the new release operates as a completely independent story. It is not a direct continuation of Quaid's earlier canine features, A Dog's Purpose and A Dog's Journey, sharing only its leading man and canine-focused premise.

Public response to the project has been overwhelmingly positive, reflected in a near-perfect audience approval rating of 95 percent on Rotten Tomatoes. Viewers praised its seasonal comfort, calling it an instant holiday classic.

Conversely, professional film critics offered a much cooler reception, resulting in a critical score of 33 percent. Reviewers like Archika Khurana of The Times of India and Alise Chaffins from Loud and Clear Reviews found the offering emotionally inconsistent or lacking the depth needed to justify the runtime.

Dennis Quaid stars in the holiday family drama A Dog's Perfect Christmas, which debuted on Netflix on November 4. The film quickly rose to become the most-watched English-language movie globally on the streaming platform during its first week.
Despite mixed reviews from professional film critics, the project resonated strongly with audiences, achieving a high approval rating and massive viewership numbers.

facts: A Dog's Perfect Christmas was released on Netflix on November 4.
The film stars Dennis Quaid, Brooke Lena Johnson, Kathleen Rose Perkins, Thomas Haden Church, Milo Ventimiglia, Mary Steenburgen, and Jennifer Tilly.
For the week of November 2 to November 8, the film achieved 8.6 million views and 14.5 million hours watched.
The movie holds a 95 percent audience score and a 33 percent critical score on Rotten Tomatoes.

articles.headline: Ramayana Approaches Historic Seventh Consecutive ₹100 Crore Worldwide Day
articles.dek: Namit Malhotra's epic is on the verge of setting a new Indian cinema benchmark by securing another ₹100 crore-plus global day on Wednesday.

p: The cinematic enterprise produced by Namit Malhotra is hurtling toward another extraordinary global milestone. Industry trackers indicate that the feature is eyeing an impressive collection of ₹105 to ₹110 crore worldwide on its seventh day in theaters.

This projected performance is expected to stretch its unprecedented streak of consecutive ₹100 crore-plus global grosses to an unbroken seven days, a feat that has never been accomplished by any previous Indian release.

What elevates this theatrical run beyond a standard blockbuster opening is its absolute consistency. While previous massive hits like Dhurandhar 2, Pushpa 2, Baahubali 2, and Jawan managed to secure four consecutive days above the ₹100 crore worldwide threshold, the Nitesh Tiwari directorial easily shattered that benchmark.

Having already maintained its winning streak across its first six days from Thursday through Tuesday, the feature has consistently dominated global box office charts with daily worldwide grosses comfortably clearing the nine-figure mark.

body.h: Breaking Down the Opening Week Numbers
p: The journey began with a massive ₹128.75 crore gross on Thursday, followed by ₹103.30 crore on Friday. The weekend saw explosive growth with ₹155.20 crore on Saturday and ₹122.95 crore on Sunday.

Weekday figures remained exceptionally robust, pulling in ₹165.70 crore on Monday and ₹147.60 crore on Tuesday, setting the stage for yet another dominant global haul by the end of its first Wednesday.
On the domestic front, the film is projected to close out Day 7 with approximately ₹65 to ₹70 crore in net collections, translating to roughly ₹80 crore in gross earnings within India.

Live tracking data showed the feature had already accumulated ₹57.38 crore net across 21,116 shows by the evening, demonstrating sustained weekday demand even as the extended Diwali holiday advantage gradually eases.

Overseas territories continue to play a pivotal role in the enterprise's global dominance, with North America emerging as a particularly strong market. The feature brought in $2.01 million on Tuesday alone, pushing its cumulative regional total to $15.65 million.
This post-weekend momentum proves that audience enthusiasm extends well beyond the initial opening rush, providing a solid foundation for the remainder of its theatrical run.

Calendar timing has also favored the international rollout. November 11 coincided with Veterans Day in the United States and Remembrance Day in Canada, with the latter observed as a public holiday in several provinces.
These observances created additional opportunities for theatrical attendance, allowing the feature to draw steady crowds across North American screens.

Namit Malhotra's Ramayana is on track to achieve an unprecedented seventh consecutive ₹100 crore-plus worldwide day on Wednesday, extending a record-breaking global streak. Backed by strong domestic collections and robust North American numbers, the Nitesh Tiwari directorial continues to rewrite Indian box office history.

facts: Namit Malhotra's Ramayana is projected to earn ₹105–110 crore worldwide on Day 7.
The overseas contribution for Day 7 is estimated at ₹25–30 crore.
Dhurandhar 2, Pushpa 2, Baahubali 2, and Jawan previously achieved four consecutive ₹100 crore-plus worldwide days.
Day 1 worldwide gross was ₹128.75 crore.
Day 2 worldwide gross was ₹103.30 crore.
Day 3 worldwide gross was ₹155.20 crore.
Day 4 worldwide gross was ₹122.95 crore.
Day 5 worldwide gross was ₹165.70 crore.
Day 6 worldwide gross was ₹147.60 crore.
Day 7 India net is estimated at ₹65–70 crore.
The film collected ₹57.38 crore net across 21,116 shows by 8:03 PM IST on Wednesday.
North America collections reached $2.01 million on Tuesday and $15.65 million cumulatively.
The film was released on Thursday, November 5, 2026.
Cumulative India net reached ₹440.45 Cr and worldwide gross reached ₹825.00 Cr.
